title: Severfield and Perega to complete HS2 station roof
content: Consultant Perega has been appointed by main steelwork contractor Severfield to design the secondary steelwork for the roof of HS2’s Old Oak Common station. The scope covers purlins, roof and soffit support elements, edge details, roof walkways and brackets for guttering and rainwater chutes. Adam Holliday, Senior Structural Engineer at Perega, said: “This is a much bigger project than anything we’d typically take on in secondary steelwork. “The end bays have their own unique details; you can’t simply repeat what you’ve already designed in the central section, so we’re looking much further ahead in the programme than we usually would. For Perega to be part of the infrastructure being built for the country means a lot to us. It’s good to be part of history.”
